content:
Details of the label applied on the resource.
JSON representation
Fields
id
string
Identifier of the label - Only the label id, not the full OnePlatform resource name.
title
string
Title of the label
fieldValues[]
object (FieldValue
(/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#FieldValue))
activities.list of fields which are part of the label and have been set by the user. If
label has a field which was not set by the user, it would not be present in this list.
reason
object (Reason
(/workspace/admin/reports/reference/rest/v1/activities/list#Reason))
The reason why the label was applied on the resource.
